notes: tei follows agape and its modifier is a prepositional phrase, so rule 31's carve-out gives it the supplied relativizer and puts the copula on en; the ASV writes no determiner for faith and love, so nothing else is in question. This is the same configuration as 1:1 and the contrast with the participle articles of 1:9 and 1:14.
hygiainonton and logon are both anarthrous with no supplied determiner, so the case preposition of stays with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause, discontinuously around the adjective.
